description: This file defines the DiscoverScreen widget for the Flutter app, which allows users to search for books from the backend, view search results, and add books to their library. It manages user input, displays loading states, and renders a list of books using custom widgets.

classes.name: DiscoverScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a UI for discovering books, including a search bar and results list.

classes.name: _DiscoverScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the search input, loading state, and rendering search results for DiscoverScreen.

methods.name: _onSearch
methods.description: Triggers search in the LibraryProvider when user submits a non-empty query.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the TextEditingController when the widget is removed from the widget tree.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI including app bar, search bar, loading indicator, 'no results' message, and list of search results.
